PostgreSQL 18. Query the semantic layer: the views in schema sem. The semantic model below describes them: entities, dimensions, measures, joins, synonyms. The raw warehouse tables (schema wh) are also queryable; they are listed at the end.

# Generated by monograph.gen.semantic_layer 1.0.0. Do not edit.
semantic_model:
  name: "drug_safety"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Semantic layer over the drug data warehouse (schema wh): FDA drug products and packages, their ingredients and labelers, adverse event reports and recalls. Query the views in schema sem; codes are already decoded into labels, dates are real dates and flags are booleans."
  entities:
    - name: "product"
      view: "sem.products"
      grain: "one row per product (product NDC)"
      description: "Drug products as listed in the FDA NDC directory, one row per product NDC (labeler and product code)."
      primary_key: "product_ndc"
      synonyms:
        - "drug product"
        - "NDC product"
        - "drug"
        - "medication"
      dimensions:
        - name: "product_ndc"
          type: "text"
          description: "Product NDC in 4-4, 5-3 or 5-4 form."
        - name: "product_name"
          type: "text"
          description: "Name as listed."
          synonyms:
            - "brand name"
            - "trade name"
        - name: "dosage_form"
          type: "text"
          description: "Dosage form as written in the source. Values are FDA SPL dosage form terms in capitals, for example 'TABLET', 'TABLET, FILM COATED', 'INJECTION, SOLUTION', 'CAPSULE'."
          synonyms:
            - "form"
            - "formulation"
        - name: "product_type"
          type: "text"
          description: "NDC directory product type."
          synonyms:
            - "marketing category"
            - "Rx or OTC"
          allowed_values:
            - "HUMAN PRESCRIPTION DRUG"
            - "HUMAN OTC DRUG"
            - "PLASMA DERIVATIVE"
            - "CELLULAR THERAPY"
            - "VACCINE"
            - "STANDARDIZED ALLERGENIC"
            - "NON-STANDARDIZED ALLERGENIC"
            - "BULK INGREDIENT"
            - "DRUG FOR FURTHER PROCESSING"
            - "LICENSED VACCINE BULK INTERMEDIATE"
        - name: "is_finished"
          type: "boolean"
          description: "Whether this is a finished product (False for bulk ingredients and intermediates)."
    - name: "product_route"
      view: "sem.product_routes"
      grain: "one row per product and route of administration"
      description: "The routes of administration of each product. A product can have several routes, so count distinct products when counting products by route."
      dimensions:
        - name: "product_ndc"
          type: "text"
          description: "The product."
          refers_to: "product"
        - name: "route"
          type: "text"
          description: "Routes of administration. Required for finished prescription and OTC products. Values are FDA SPL route terms in capitals, for example 'ORAL', 'INTRAVENOUS', 'TOPICAL', 'SUBCUTANEOUS'."
          synonyms:
            - "route of administration"
            - "administration route"
    - name: "product_ingredient"
      view: "sem.product_ingredients"
      grain: "one row per product and active ingredient"
      description: "The active ingredients of each product, with their strength. A product with several active ingredients has several rows."
      synonyms:
        - "active ingredient"
        - "ingredient"
      dimensions:
        - name: "product_ndc"
          type: "text"
          description: "The product."
          refers_to: "product"
        - name: "substance_unii"
          type: "text"
          description: "The active ingredient substance, by UNII."
          refers_to: "substance"
        - name: "strength_value"
          type: "numeric"
          description: "Numeric strength."
        - name: "strength_unit"
          type: "text"
          description: "Unit of the strength, for example mg/1."
    - name: "substance"
      view: "sem.substances"
      grain: "one row per substance (UNII)"
      description: "Substances (active ingredients) from the FDA substance registry, identified by UNII."
      primary_key: "substance_unii"
      synonyms:
        - "active ingredient"
        - "molecule"
        - "compound"
      dimensions:
        - name: "substance_unii"
          type: "text"
          description: "FDA UNII code."

          type: "text"
          description: "Preferred name."

    - name: "firm"
      view: "sem.firms"
      grain: "one row per firm"
      description: "Firms: labelers of packages and recalling firms of recalls."
      primary_key: "firm_code"
      synonyms:

        - "labeler"
        - "organization"

      dimensions:
        - name: "firm_code"
          type: "text"
          description: "Stable key: the normalized name, lowercase, words joined by hyphens."
        - name: "firm_name"
          type: "text"
          description: "Preferred name."
          synonyms:

            - "manufacturer name"
    - name: "package"
      view: "sem.packages"
      grain: "one row per package (package NDC)"
      description: "Packages (package NDCs). Each package belongs to one product and is labeled by one firm; a product usually has several packages, so count distinct products when counting products through packages."
      primary_key: "package_ndc"
      synonyms:

        - "SKU"
        - "pack"
      dimensions:

          type: "text"
          description: "The product packaged."
          refers_to: "product"
        - name: "labeler_firm_code"
          type: "text"
          description: "The labeler firm."
          refers_to: "firm"

          type: "text"

    - name: "adverse_event_report"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_reports"
      grain: "one row per adverse event report"
      description: "Adverse event reports (FAERS / openFDA), one row per report."
      primary_key: "report_id"

            - "faers_qde"
        - name: "received_date"
          type: "date"
          description: "Date FDA received the report."
          synonyms:

          type: "boolean"
          description: "Whether the report is serious."
          synonyms:

          type: "boolean"
          description: "True when the report's seriousness criteria include 'death'."

          type: "boolean"
          description: "True when the report's seriousness criteria include 'life threatening'."

          type: "boolean"
          description: "True when the report's seriousness criteria include 'hospitalization'."

          type: "boolean"
          description: "True when the report's seriousness criteria include 'disabling'."
        - name: "congenital_anomaly"
          type: "boolean"
          description: "True when the report's seriousness criteria include 'congenital anomaly'."
        - name: "other_serious"
          type: "boolean"
          description: "True when the report's seriousness criteria include 'other'."
        - name: "patient_age_years"
          type: "numeric"
          description: "Patient age at onset, in years."
          synonyms:
            - "age"
    - name: "adverse_event_reaction"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_reactions"
      grain: "one row per reaction listed on a report"
      description: "The reactions listed on each report, in report order. A report lists several reactions and can list the same term more than once, so count distinct reports when counting reports by reaction."
      synonyms:
        - "reaction"
        - "adverse reaction"
      dimensions:
        - name: "report_id"
          type: "text"
          description: "The report."
          refers_to: "adverse_event_report"
        - name: "reaction_term"
          type: "text"
          description: "MedDRA PT text (at most 100 characters)."
          synonyms:
            - "reaction"
            - "adverse reaction"
            - "event term"
            - "MedDRA term"
    - name: "adverse_event_drug"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_drugs"
      grain: "one row per drug listed on a report"
      description: "The drugs listed on each report as the reporter named them, with their role."
      synonyms:
        - "suspect drug"
        - "concomitant drug"
      dimensions:
        - name: "report_id"
          type: "text"
          description: "The report."
          refers_to: "adverse_event_report"
        - name: "drug_name"
          type: "text"
          description: "Drug name exactly as reported."
        - name: "drug_role"
          type: "text"
          description: "Role in the report."
          allowed_values:
            - "primary suspect"
            - "secondary suspect"
            - "suspect"
            - "concomitant"
            - "interacting"
    - name: "recall"
      view: "sem.recalls"
      grain: "one row per recall"
      description: "Drug recalls (FDA enforcement reports), one row per recall."
      primary_key: "recall_number"
      synonyms:
        - "enforcement report"
        - "product recall"
        - "recall event"
      dimensions:
        - name: "recall_number"
          type: "text"
          description: "FDA recall number, for example D-321-2016 or D-0123-2025."
        - name: "recall_class"
          type: "text"
          description: "Class. Class I is the most serious."
          synonyms:
            - "classification"
            - "recall classification"
            - "severity"
          allowed_values:
            - "I"
            - "II"
            - "III"
        - name: "reason"
          type: "text"
          description: "Reason for the recall."
        - name: "report_date"
          type: "date"
          description: "Enforcement report date."
        - name: "recalling_firm_code"
          type: "text"
          description: "The recalling firm."
          refers_to: "firm"
          synonyms:
            - "recalling firm"
            - "firm that recalled"
    - name: "recall_product"
      view: "sem.recall_products"
      grain: "one row per recall and product it names"
      description: "The products each recall names. A recall can name several products and a product can be in several recalls; count distinct recalls or distinct products as the question needs."
      synonyms:
        - "recalled product"
      dimensions:
        - name: "recall_number"
          type: "text"
          description: "The recall."
          refers_to: "recall"
        - name: "product_ndc"
          type: "text"
          description: "A product it names."
          refers_to: "product"
  measures:
    - name: "product_count"
      view: "sem.products"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT product_ndc)"
      grain: "product"
      description: "Number of distinct products."
    - name: "package_count"
      view: "sem.packages"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT package_ndc)"
      grain: "package"
      description: "Number of distinct packages."
    - name: "substance_count"
      view: "sem.substances"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT substance_unii)"
      grain: "substance"
      description: "Number of distinct substances."
    - name: "labeler_count"
      view: "sem.packages"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT labeler_firm_code)"
      grain: "firm"
      description: "Number of distinct firms that label at least one package."
      synonyms:
        - "number of labelers"
    - name: "report_count"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_reports"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT report_id)"
      grain: "adverse_event_report"
      description: "Number of distinct adverse event reports."
      synonyms:
        - "number of cases"
        - "case count"
    - name: "serious_report_count"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_reports"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT report_id) FILTER (WHERE is_serious)"
      grain: "adverse_event_report"
      description: "Number of distinct serious adverse event reports."
      synonyms:
        - "serious cases"
    - name: "death_report_count"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_reports"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT report_id) FILTER (WHERE resulted_in_death)"
      grain: "adverse_event_report"
      description: "Number of distinct reports whose seriousness criteria include death."
      synonyms:
        - "fatal reports"
        - "deaths"
    - name: "average_patient_age"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_reports"
      sql: "AVG(patient_age_years)"
      grain: "adverse_event_report"
      description: "Average patient age in years over reports that give an age, each report counted once."
      synonyms:
        - "mean age"
    - name: "reaction_mention_count"
      view: "sem.adverse_event_reactions"
      sql: "COUNT(*)"
      grain: "adverse_event_reaction"
      description: "Number of reaction rows (a report listing a term twice counts twice)."
    - name: "recall_count"
      view: "sem.recalls"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT recall_number)"
      grain: "recall"
      description: "Number of distinct recalls."
      synonyms:
        - "number of enforcement reports"
    - name: "class_1_recall_count"
      view: "sem.recalls"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT recall_number) FILTER (WHERE recall_class = 'I')"
      grain: "recall"
      description: "Number of distinct Class I recalls."
      synonyms:
        - "most serious recalls"
    - name: "recalled_product_count"
      view: "sem.recall_products"
      sql: "COUNT(DISTINCT product_ndc)"
      grain: "product"
      description: "Number of distinct products named by at least one recall."
  joins:
    - name: "package_product"
      left: "sem.packages"
      right: "sem.products"
      on: "sem.packages.product_ndc = sem.products.product_ndc"
      relationship: "many_to_one"
      description: "A package belongs to one product."
    - name: "package_labeler"
      left: "sem.packages"
      right: "sem.firms"
      on: "sem.packages.labeler_firm_code = sem.firms.firm_code"
      relationship: "many_to_one"
      description: "A package is labeled by one firm."
    - name: "product_routes"
      left: "sem.products"
      right: "sem.product_routes"
      on: "sem.products.product_ndc = sem.product_routes.product_ndc"
      relationship: "one_to_many"
      description: "A product has one or more routes."
    - name: "product_ingredients"
      left: "sem.products"
      right: "sem.product_ingredients"
      on: "sem.products.product_ndc = sem.product_ingredients.product_ndc"
      relationship: "one_to_many"
      description: "A product has one or more active ingredients."
    - name: "ingredient_substance"
      left: "sem.product_ingredients"
      right: "sem.substances"
      on: "sem.product_ingredients.substance_unii = sem.substances.substance_unii"
      relationship: "many_to_one"
      description: "An ingredient is one substance."
    - name: "report_reactions"
      left: "sem.adverse_event_reports"
      right: "sem.adverse_event_reactions"
      on: "sem.adverse_event_reports.report_id = sem.adverse_event_reactions.report_id"
      relationship: "one_to_many"
      description: "A report lists one or more reactions."
    - name: "report_drugs"
      left: "sem.adverse_event_reports"
      right: "sem.adverse_event_drugs"
      on: "sem.adverse_event_reports.report_id = sem.adverse_event_drugs.report_id"
      relationship: "one_to_many"
      description: "A report lists one or more drugs."
    - name: "recall_products"
      left: "sem.recalls"
      right: "sem.recall_products"
      on: "sem.recalls.recall_number = sem.recall_products.recall_number"
      relationship: "one_to_many"
      description: "A recall names zero or more products."
    - name: "recalled_product"
      left: "sem.recall_products"
      right: "sem.products"
      on: "sem.recall_sem.products.product_ndc = sem.products.product_ndc"
      relationship: "many_to_one"
      description: "Each recalled product row is one product."
    - name: "recall_firm"
      left: "sem.recalls"
      right: "sem.firms"
      on: "sem.recalls.recalling_firm_code = sem.firms.firm_code"
      relationship: "many_to_one"
      description: "A recall has one recalling firm."

Views (schema sem):

VIEW sem.products (one row per product (product NDC)) (
    product_ndc text,
    product_name text,
    dosage_form text,
    product_type text,
    is_finished boolean
)

VIEW sem.product_routes (one row per product and route of administration) (
    product_ndc text,
    route text
)

VIEW sem.product_ingredients (one row per product and active ingredient) (
    product_ndc text,
    substance_unii text,
    strength_value numeric,
    strength_unit text
)

VIEW sem.substances (one row per substance (UNII)) (
    substance_unii text,
    substance_name text
)

VIEW sem.firms (one row per firm) (
    firm_code text,
    firm_name text
)

VIEW sem.packages (one row per package (package NDC)) (
    package_ndc text,
    product_ndc text,
    labeler_firm_code text,
    package_description text
)

VIEW sem.adverse_event_reports (one row per adverse event report) (
    report_id text,
    source_system text,
    received_date date,
    is_serious boolean,
    resulted_in_death boolean,
    was_life_threatening boolean,
    caused_hospitalization boolean,
    caused_disability boolean,
    congenital_anomaly boolean,
    other_serious boolean,
    patient_age_years numeric
)

VIEW sem.adverse_event_reactions (one row per reaction listed on a report) (
    report_id text,
    reaction_term text
)

VIEW sem.adverse_event_drugs (one row per drug listed on a report) (
    report_id text,
    drug_name text,
    drug_role text
)

VIEW sem.recalls (one row per recall) (
    recall_number text,
    recall_class text,
    reason text,
    report_date date,
    recalling_firm_code text
)

VIEW sem.recall_products (one row per recall and product it names) (
    recall_number text,
    product_ndc text
)

Raw warehouse tables (schema wh), not described by the semantic layer:

CREATE TABLE wh.T_REF_CD (
    CD_DOM varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    CD_VAL varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    CD_DSC varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    SORT_ORD integer,
    PRIMARY KEY (CD_DOM, CD_VAL)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_SUBST_MSTR (
    SUBST_SK integer NOT NULL,
    UNII_CD varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    SUBST_NM varchar(400) NOT NULL,
    LGCY_SUBST_ID varchar(20),
    PRIMARY KEY (SUBST_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.X_SALT_MOIETY (
    SUBST_SK integer NOT NULL,
    MOIETY_SUBST_SK integer NOT NULL,
    SRC_TXT varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (SUBST_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_ORG_MSTR (
    ORG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    ORG_CD varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    ORG_NM varchar(400) NOT NULL,
    DUNS_NO varchar(9),
    PRIMARY KEY (ORG_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.X_ORG_ALIAS (
    ORG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    ALIAS_NM varchar(400) NOT NULL,
    SRC_CD varchar(8) NOT NULL,
    EVID_TXT text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ORG_SK, ALIAS_NM)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_CLIN_DRG (
    CLIN_DRG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    RXCUI varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    CLIN_DRG_NM text,
    TTY_CD varchar(8),
    PRIMARY KEY (CLIN_DRG_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.X_BRND_GNRC (
    BRND_CLIN_DRG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    GNRC_CLIN_DRG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    SRC_TXT varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (BRND_CLIN_DRG_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_PRD_MSTR (
    PRD_SK integer NOT NULL,
    PRD_CD varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    PRD_NM varchar(400) NOT NULL,
    DSG_FRM_CD varchar(8) NOT NULL,
    PRD_TYP_CD varchar(8) NOT NULL,
    FNSHD_FLG char(1) NOT NULL,
    RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK integer,
    OLD_PRD_CD varchar(12),
    DSG_FRM_TXT varchar(200),
    PRIMARY KEY (PRD_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_PRD_RTE (
    PRD_SK integer NOT NULL,
    RTE_CD varchar(8) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRD_SK, RTE_CD)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_PRD_INGR (
    PRD_SK integer NOT NULL,
    INGR_SEQ integer NOT NULL,
    SUBST_SK integer NOT NULL,
    STRNTH_VAL numeric NOT NULL,
    STRNTH_UOM varchar(60) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRD_SK, INGR_SEQ)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.X_NDC_RXN (
    PRD_SK integer NOT NULL,
    MAP_SEQ integer NOT NULL,
    CLIN_DRG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    SRC_CD varchar(8) NOT NULL,
    EVID_TXT text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRD_SK, MAP_SEQ)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_PKG (
    PKG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    PKG_NDC varchar(14) NOT NULL,

);

    LOAD_BATCH_ID integer,

    PRD_NM varchar(400),
    DSG_FRM_LGCY_CD varchar(4),
    RTE_LGCY_CD varchar(4),
    PRD_TYP_TXT varchar(60),
    LOAD_DT integer
);

CREATE TABLE wh.STG_RCL_FEED (
    FEED_ROW_ID integer,
    DELIVERY_NO integer,
    RECALL_NUMBER varchar(20),
    CLASSIFICATION varchar(20),
    REPORT_DATE_TXT varchar(10),
    RECALLING_FIRM varchar(400)
);
